mapper.sql:
, bindings AS ( SELECT b.*, b.config_json::jsonb->'workRule' AS rule, (b.config_json::jsonb->'workRule'->>'minutes')::numeric +coalesce((b.config_json::jsonb->'workRule'->>'adjustmentMinutes')::numeric,0) AS unit_minutes FROM public.nocode_task_entry_binding b JOIN nodes n ON n.id=b.task_id WHERE b.deleted=0 AND b.config_json::jsonb->'workRule'->>'mode' IS NOT NULL ), raw_facts AS ( SELECT f.id,f.task_id,f.entry_key,f.dataset_id,f.creator,f.create_time, b.config_json::jsonb->>'name' AS entry_name, coalesce(f.work_rule_json::jsonb,b.rule) AS rule, (coalesce(f.work_rule_json::jsonb,b.rule)->>'minutes')::numeric +coalesce((coalesce(f.work_rule_json::jsonb,b.rule)->>'adjustmentMinutes')::numeric,0) AS unit_minutes, f.snapshot_json::jsonb->'record'->'values' AS values, CASE WHEN f.business_json::jsonb->>'requestId' IS NULL THEN f.business_json::jsonb->>'recordId' ELSE approved.record_id END AS record_id FROM public.nocode_task_entry_record f JOIN bindings b ON b.task_id=f.task_id AND b.entry_key=f.entry_key AND b.dataset_id=f.dataset_id LEFT JOIN public.nocode_handling_request approved ON approved.id::text=f.business_json::jsonb->>'requestId' AND approved.deleted=0 AND approved.status='APPROVED' AND approved.creator=f.creator AND approved.application_id::text=f.business_json::jsonb->'resource'->>'applicationId' AND approved.application_version::text=f.business_json::jsonb->'resource'->>'applicationVersion' AND approved.object_id::text=f.business_json::jsonb->'object'->>'objectId' WHERE f.deleted=0 AND f.superseded_by IS NULL AND f.operation IN ('CREATED','UPDATED') AND f.snapshot_json IS NOT NULL AND f.creator ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND f.creator=CAST(#{q.employeeId} AS varchar) ), valued AS ( SELECT f.*, CASE f.rule->>'mode' WHEN 'RECORD_ONCE' THEN 1 WHEN 'QUANTITY' THEN CASE WHEN (f.values->>(f.rule->>'quantityFieldId')) ~ '^[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$' THEN greatest((f.values->>(f.rule->>'quantityFieldId'))::numeric,0) ELSE 0 END WHEN 'CONDITION' THEN CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(f.values->(f.rule->>'conditionFieldId'))='number' OR jsonb_typeof(f.rule->'conditionValue')='number' THEN CASE WHEN (f.values->>(f.rule->>'conditionFieldId')) ~ '^[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$' AND (f.rule->>'conditionValue') ~ '^[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$' THEN CASE WHEN (f.values->>(f.rule->>'conditionFieldId'))::numeric=(f.rule->>'conditionValue')::numeric THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END WHEN f.values->>(f.rule->>'conditionFieldId')=f.rule->>'conditionValue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS measured_quantity FROM raw_facts f WHERE f.record_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_task_entry_record removed WHERE removed.dataset_id=f.dataset_id AND removed.deleted=0 AND removed.superseded_by IS NULL AND removed.operation='DELETED' AND removed.business_json::jsonb->>'recordId'=f.record_id ) ), ordered_work AS ( SELECT v.*, lag(measured_quantity,1,0::numeric) OVER identity_order AS previous_quantity, min(measured_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY task_id,entry_key,creator,record_id ORDER BY create_time,id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS remaining_quantity
FROM valued v WHERE unit_minutes>0 OR (unit_minutes=0 AND rule->>'mode'='QUANTITY') WINDOW identity_order AS (PARTITION BY task_id,entry_key,creator,record_id ORDER BY create_time,id) ), segments AS (
SELECT w.*,greatest(least(measured_quantity,remaining_quantity)-previous_quantity,0) AS segment_quantity FROM ordered_work w ), measured AS ( SELECT task_id,entry_key,max(entry_name) AS entry_name,creator::bigint AS employee_id,record_id, max(rule->>'mode') AS rule_mode, CASE WHEN max(rule->>'mode')='QUANTITY' THEN CASE WHEN min(unit_minutes) FILTER(WHERE segment_quantity>0 AND unit_minutes>0)=max(unit_minutes) FILTER(WHERE segment_quantity>0 AND unit_minutes>0) THEN min(unit_minutes) FILTER(WHERE segment_quantity>0 AND unit_minutes>0) ELSE NULL END ELSE (array_agg(unit_minutes ORDER BY create_time,id) FILTER(WHERE measured_quantity>0))[1] END AS unit_minutes, CASE WHEN max(rule->>'mode')='QUANTITY' THEN sum(segment_quantity) FILTER(WHERE unit_minutes>0) ELSE max(measured_quantity) END AS quantity, CASE WHEN max(rule->>'mode')='QUANTITY' THEN sum(segment_quantity*unit_minutes) ELSE (array_agg(unit_minutes ORDER BY create_time,id) FILTER(WHERE measured_quantity>0))[1] END AS standard_minutes, min(create_time) FILTER(WHERE measured_quantity>0 AND unit_minutes>0) AS first_counted_at, max(create_time) AS last_handled_at FROM segments GROUP BY task_id,entry_key,creator,record_id ), period_work AS ( SELECT m.*,n.root_id FROM measured m JOIN nodes n ON n.id=m.task_id WHERE m.standard_minutes>0 AND m.first_counted_at>=CAST(#{q.from} AS date) AND m.first_counted_at<CAST(#{q.to} AS date)+INTERVAL '1 day' ), node_counts AS ( SELECT n.assignee_id AS employee_id, count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.status='COMPLETED' AND n.actual_end>=CAST(#{q.from} AS date) AND n.actual_end<CAST(#{q.to} AS date)+INTERVAL '1 day') AS completed_node_count, count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','PAUSED','PENDING_ACCEPTANCE')) AS active_node_count, count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','PAUSED','PENDING_ACCEPTANCE') AND n.expected_end<localtimestamp) AS overdue_node_count FROM employee_leaf_nodes n GROUP BY n.assignee_id )
mapper.select: SELECT coalesce((SELECT sum(standard_minutes) FROM period_work),0) AS standard_minutes, (SELECT count(*) FROM period_work) AS record_count, (SELECT count(DISTINCT employee_id) FROM period_work) AS employee_count, coalesce((SELECT sum(completed_node_count) FROM node_counts),0)::bigint AS completed_node_count, coalesce((SELECT sum(active_node_count) FROM node_counts),0)::bigint AS active_node_count, coalesce((SELECT sum(overdue_node_count) FROM node_counts),0)::bigint AS overdue_node_count
SELECT first_counted_at::date AS date,sum(standard_minutes) AS standard_minutes,count(*) AS record_count FROM period_work GROUP BY first_counted_at::date ORDER BY date

SELECT w.employee_id,coalesce(u.nickname,'员工 ' || w.employee_id) AS employee_name, sum(w.standard_minutes) AS standard_minutes,count(*) AS record_count FROM period_work w LEFT JOIN public.system_users u ON u.id=w.employee_id AND u.deleted=0 GROUP BY w.employee_id,u.nickname ORDER BY standard_minutes DESC,w.employee_id LIMIT 10
mapper.sql: , work_counts AS ( SELECT employee_id,sum(standard_minutes) AS standard_minutes,count(*) AS record_count, count(DISTINCT root_id) AS participated_task_count FROM period_work GROUP BY employee_id ), employee_rows AS ( SELECT coalesce(w.employee_id,n.employee_id) AS employee_id, coalesce(u.nickname,'员工 ' || coalesce(w.employee_id,n.employee_id)) AS employee_name, coalesce(w.standard_minutes,0) AS standard_minutes,coalesce(w.record_count,0) AS record_count, coalesce(w.participated_task_count,0) AS participated_task_count, coalesce(n.completed_node_count,0) AS completed_node_count, coalesce(n.active_node_count,0) AS active_node_count,coalesce(n.overdue_node_count,0) AS overdue_node_count FROM work_counts w FULL JOIN node_counts n ON n.employee_id=w.employee_id LEFT JOIN public.system_users u ON u.id=coalesce(w.employee_id,n.employee_id) AND u.deleted=0 WHERE coalesce(w.employee_id,n.employee_id) IS NOT NULL AND (coalesce(w.record_count,0)>0 OR coalesce(n.completed_node_count,0)>0 OR coalesce(n.active_node_count,0)>0) )

ORDER BY
record_count completed_node_count overdue_node_count standard_minutes
DESCASC

, root_work AS ( SELECT root_id,sum(standard_minutes) AS standard_minutes,count(*) AS record_count, count(DISTINCT employee_id) AS employee_count FROM period_work GROUP BY root_id ), root_nodes AS ( SELECT n.root_id,count(*) AS total_node_count, count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.status='COMPLETED') AS completed_node_count, count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.status='CANCELLED') AS cancelled_node_count, count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','PAUSED','PENDING_ACCEPTANCE') AND n.expected_end<localtimestamp) AS overdue_node_count FROM leaf_nodes n GROUP BY n.root_id ), task_rows AS ( SELECT r.id AS root_task_id,r.title,r.template_id,coalesce(v.name,t.name) AS template_name, r.template_version,r.status,r.assignee_id, CASE WHEN r.assignee_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE coalesce(u.nickname,'员工 ' || r.assignee_id) END AS assignee_name, (r.config_json::jsonb->>'effectiveWorkMinutes')::integer AS reference_minutes, coalesce(w.standard_minutes,0) AS standard_minutes,coalesce(w.record_count,0) AS record_count, coalesce(w.employee_count,0) AS employee_count,coalesce(n.completed_node_count,0) AS completed_node_count, coalesce(n.total_node_count,0) AS total_node_count,coalesce(n.cancelled_node_count,0) AS cancelled_node_count, coalesce(n.overdue_node_count,0) AS overdue_node_count, r.expected_end,r.actual_start,r.actual_end, CASE WHEN r.status='COMPLETED' AND r.actual_start IS NOT NULL AND r.actual_end IS NOT NULL THEN greatest(extract(epoch FROM r.actual_end-r.actual_start)/60,0) ELSE NULL END AS elapsed_minutes FROM roots r LEFT JOIN root_work w ON w.root_id=r.id LEFT JOIN root_nodes n ON n.root_id=r.id LEFT JOIN public.nocode_task_template_version v ON v.template_id=r.template_id AND v.version_no=r.template_version AND v.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN public.nocode_task_template t ON t.id=r.template_id AND t.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN public.system_users u ON u.id=r.assignee_id AND u.deleted=0 WHERE (w.root_id IS NOT NULL OR (r.create_time<CAST(#{q.to} AS date)+INTERVAL '1 day' AND (r.actual_end IS NULL OR r.actual_end>=CAST(#{q.from} AS date)))) AND (w.root_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM employee_leaf_nodes own_node WHERE own_node.root_id=r.id)) )

sql.if: WHERE (n.title ILIKE '%' || #{q.search} || '%' OR w.entry_name ILIKE '%' || #{q.search} || '%' OR r.title ILIKE '%' || #{q.search} || '%' OR w.record_id ILIKE '%' || #{q.search} || '%' OR coalesce(u.nickname,'员工 ' || w.employee_id) ILIKE '%' || #{q.search} || '%')

mapper.select:
SELECT w.task_id,n.title AS task_title,n.root_id AS root_task_id,r.title AS root_title, w.entry_key,w.entry_name,w.employee_id,coalesce(u.nickname,'员工 ' || w.employee_id) AS employee_name, w.record_id,w.rule_mode,w.unit_minutes,w.quantity,w.standard_minutes, w.first_counted_at,w.last_handled_at FROM period_work w JOIN nodes n ON n.id=w.task_id JOIN roots r ON r.id=n.root_id LEFT JOIN public.system_users u ON u.id=w.employee_id AND u.deleted=0
ORDER BY w.first_counted_at DESC,w.task_id,w.entry_key,w.employee_id,w.record_id
SELECT count(*) FROM period_work w JOIN nodes n ON n.id=w.task_id JOIN roots r ON r.id=n.root_id LEFT JOIN public.system_users u ON u.id=w.employee_id AND u.deleted=0

, employee_ids AS ( SELECT assignee_id AS id FROM nodes WHERE assignee_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT f.creator::bigint FROM public.nocode_task_entry_record f JOIN nodes n ON n.id=f.task_id WHERE f.deleted=0 AND f.creator ~ '^[0-9]+$' ) SELECT e.id,coalesce(u.nickname,'员工 ' || e.id) AS name FROM employee_ids e LEFT JOIN public.system_users u ON u.id=e.id AND u.deleted=0 WHERE coalesce(u.nickname,'员工 ' || e.id) ILIKE '%' || #{q.search} || '%' ORDER BY name,e.id LIMIT 200

SELECT r.template_id AS id,coalesce(t.name,max(v.name),'历史模板') AS name FROM roots r LEFT JOIN public.nocode_task_template t ON t.id=r.template_id AND t.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN public.nocode_task_template_version v ON v.template_id=r.template_id AND v.version_no=r.template_version AND v.deleted=0 WHERE r.template_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.template_id,t.name HAVING coalesce(t.name,max(v.name),'历史模板') ILIKE '%' || #{q.search} || '%' ORDER BY name,r.template_id LIMIT 200
